rules.statement: A fidei commissum may be so purely in the nature of what the English law terms a trust as not to interfere with the vesting of the fideicommissary legatee's interest even before the arrival of the time for the payment of the legacy.
rules.supporting_quote: "A fidei commissum may be so purely in the nature of what the English law terms a trust as not to interfere with the vesting of the fideicommissary legatee's interest even before the arrival of the time for the payment of the legacy." (Strydom v. Strydom's Trustee 3, page 287)
